text.content:
The food you eat, the drugs you take, the fuel in your tank.

Headquarters: Regional HQ in the Corporate Plaza
Industry: Biotech: food, pharmaceuticals, and the CHOOH2 biofuel
In Night City: Owns huge tracts south of the city where protein worms are farmed for scop
Dealing with edgerunners: Pays well for samples, people and research that walk out of rival labs

If something changed in biotech over the last century, Biotechnica either did it or bought whoever did. It developed CHOOH2, the alcohol fuel brewed from engineered wheat, and licenses it to companies like Petrochem and SovOil.

The Biotechnica Flats south of Night City grow the worms that most of the city eats as scop, whatever shape and flavor it's dyed into.

Gig hooks

  • A farm crew in the Flats has stopped answering calls.
  • A test batch of a new scop flavor is making people sick in Santo Domingo.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.23
